title: A supertetrahedral T2 [Mn4Ce6] cluster showing second-harmonic generation response

synthesis.procedure: NEt3 (28 µL, 0.2 mmol) was added to a yellow solution of acndH2 (0.043 g, 0.2 mmol) in MeOH/DMF (15 mL, 1:2 v/v), giving a dark yellow solution. MnCl2·4H2O (0.02 g, 0.1 mmol) and Ce(acac)3·xH2O (0.15 g, 0.3 mmol) were then added and the solution immediately turned dark brown. The mixture was stirred for 2 h, insoluble material was removed by filtration, and the filtrate was kept at about 20 °C for two months to afford dark brown crystals of compound 1. The main text states that MnII and CeIII are oxidized in situ under aerobic conditions to MnIII and CeIV, and that part of the acac− is oxidized to acetate.
synthesis.temperature: stirring not otherwise specified; crystallization at ~20 °C
synthesis.time: stirred 2 h; crystallization for two months
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reaction in MeOH/DMF, stirring, filtration, and ambient crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Insoluble material was filtered off; dark brown crystals formed from the filtrate after two months at ~20 °C.

properties.summary: Compound 1 shows a weak, phase-matchable second-harmonic generation response attributed to its chiral structure and the helical packing of discrete T2 clusters. Magnetic data indicate very weak antiferromagnetic coupling among the four high-spin MnIII ions; CeIV is diamagnetic.
